name: @w6w-apps/pushbullet
description: Send push notifications, links, files and SMS across devices via Pushbullet.

w6w.longDescription:
Pushbullet bridges phones, browsers and desktops: a note, link or file pushed from a workflow shows up as a native notification on every device signed into the account, or on one device, or to another person's email, or to every subscriber of a broadcast channel.

This app covers Pushbullet's full HTTP API: sending and managing pushes (notes, links and files), registering and managing devices, one-to-one chats, broadcast channels and subscriptions, and SMS/MMS sent through an Android device's own number. Health checks track the account's live API rate-limit headroom — genuinely readable from response headers, unlike most vendors in this pack — alongside honest declarations for the two things Pushbullet does not expose: a public status page, and remaining monthly push allowance.
